rationale: C17 plausibly supplied a material drafting template because the child generalizes its two-level administrative machinery: department heads bear responsibility for an effective program and conduct regular appraisals, while a central body advises agencies, coordinates their efforts, disseminates information, reviews progress, and reports to the President. The overlap extends beyond generic committee boilerplate to a closely parallel allocation and sequence of management functions. C06 is also strong in its use of agency surveys, economy-and-efficiency review, scheduling, central guidance, and reporting, while C20 provides a weaker parallel involving a government-wide program, agency implementation, assistance, information exchange, and recommendations for improvement.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Department and agency heads shall ... provide for periodic and systematic appraisals of operations to identify opportunities to improve effectiveness and performance
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The head of each department shall be personally responsible for an effective program ... [and the Fair Employment Officer shall] appraise the personnel actions of the department at regular intervals
shared_material.explanation: Both place responsibility for an effective departmental program at the agency-head level and require recurring appraisal of agency operations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Bureau of the Budget shall ... advise and assist the agencies ... provide for an interchange of information ... and ... report periodically to the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Board shall ... advise all departments ... disseminate information ... coordinate the ... programs ... [and] make reports and submit recommendations ... for transmittal to the President
shared_material.explanation: The central coordinating body's functions follow a distinctive shared bundle: agency advice, information dissemination, interdepartmental coordination, and presidential reporting.

shared_material.child_excerpt: reviewing the progress of agency management improvement efforts
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Have authority to review decisions made by the head of any department ... and to make recommendations to such head
shared_material.explanation: Both establish centralized review of departmental implementation coupled with recommendations or assistance to department heads.
